description: Payload validator allows prototype/dunder key injection and fails to enforce recursion depth bounds on nested structures.
spec_notes: PayloadValidator must enforce max_depth and block dunder/special attributes across all nested dicts and lists.

repo_files.schema_rule.py:
"""Schema rule constraints for payload fields."""

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional


@dataclass
class FieldRule:
    name: str
    field_type: type
    max_len: Optional[int] = None
    required: bool = True

tests.test_payload_boundary.py:
from request_context import ValidationContext
from validator import PayloadValidator


def test_valid_shallow_payload():
    v = PayloadValidator(max_depth=3, max_keys=5)
    ctx = ValidationContext()
    v.validate({"name": "item", "count": 10}, ctx)
    assert ctx.is_valid is True
    assert len(ctx.violations) == 0


def test_deeply_nested_payload_depth_violation():
    v = PayloadValidator(max_depth=2, max_keys=10)
    ctx = ValidationContext()
    # Depth 4 payload: level1 -> level2 -> level3 -> level4
    nested = {"a": {"b": {"c": {"d": 1}}}}
    v.validate(nested, ctx)
    assert ctx.is_valid is False
    assert any("depth exceeds limit" in err for err in ctx.violations)


def test_dunder_attribute_injection_blocked():
    v = PayloadValidator(max_depth=3, max_keys=10)
    for bad_key in ["__proto__", "__class__", "__globals__", "__dict__"]:
        ctx = ValidationContext()
        v.validate({"user": {bad_key: "exploit"}}, ctx)
        assert ctx.is_valid is False
        assert any("Forbidden special attribute" in err for err in ctx.violations)


def test_key_count_limit_enforced():
    v = PayloadValidator(max_depth=3, max_keys=3)
    ctx = ValidationContext()
    v.validate({"k1": 1, "k2": 2, "k3": 3, "k4": 4}, ctx)
    assert ctx.is_valid is False
    assert any("key count exceeds limit" in err for err in ctx.violations)


def test_nested_list_dictionary_depth_tracked():
    v = PayloadValidator(max_depth=2, max_keys=10)
    ctx = ValidationContext()
    # Depth 3 via list of dicts
    v.validate({"items": [{"meta": {"deep": "val"}}]}, ctx)
    assert ctx.is_valid is False
    assert any("depth exceeds limit" in err for err in ctx.violations)
